name: Sergius
source:
The greatest living legatus, or general, in all Raskya, Sergius was the commander of the war against Dagara, finally conquering the land after a bloody six year campaign. Traditional to a fault, he worships the Ghosts of War, the spirits that Raskyans believe have dominion over all human combat and conflict. As such, when his former protege and rival Sejanus seemingly betrays Raskya by capturing the capital of Dagara himself, Sergius eagerly puts the city under siege, and can hardly contain his excitement to sacrifice everyone inside to the Ghosts.

[From [url=https://www.basileusgames.com/]official website[/url]]
